decision_note: Mis-anchored. Expertise reversal states that SUPPORT harms EXPERTS; this pattern withholds advanced FEATURES from NOVICES, which runs the effect backwards. Hiding complexity from a beginner is justified by general cognitive load, not by cl-14-002, and its only quote is the effect's own sentence, so nothing in its evidence half supports the direction it takes. If it returns it must anchor to a CL-14 load effect, not to expertise reversal.
